comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Will patch the banner predicate to prefer first_response_at and treat public comments as a fallback only.

content.text: Will patch the banner predicate to prefer first_response_at and treat public comments as a fallback only.

The red "SLA breached — first response overdue" banner still appears on triage tickets whose first_response_at is already populated. Spotted on tickets that were answered via the mobile agent app; portal-origin replies seem fine.

When first_response_at is non-null the banner and the sla_state=breached badge should both clear. Instead the banner stays and the queue list still paints the ticket crimson even though the detail pane shows a first response timestamp.

Working theory: the banner query joins on the first public comment's created_at rather than the denormalized first_response_at column. Mobile replies write first_response_at through a different code path that does not also insert a "public" comment flag the join expects, so the breach view keeps matching.
